traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus, Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Disruption meets imagination. A generational signature: radical ideals and visionary change. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of disruption and imagination is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Generational and visionary themes rather than a personal day-to-day read.
shadow: Instability for its own sake fused with illusion and escapism, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
base: A new possibility can look like the future when it gives shape to something people had nearly stopped believing could change.

readerCopy.body: A new possibility can look like the future when it gives shape to something people had nearly stopped believing could change. When Uranus conjoins Neptune, innovation and imagination fuse, making a new idea, technology, community, or way of living carry enormous hope before its limits are known. The possibility can wake something up without being required to solve everything immediately. Hope becomes more useful once the new thing has enough time to show what it actually changes.
